description: This file contains utility functions for visualizing object detection results, including drawing bounding boxes, captions, detections, and annotations on images, specifically for use with the RetinaNet object detection framework.

methods.name: draw_box
methods.description: Draws a rectangle box on an image at specified coordinates with a given color and thickness.

methods.name: draw_caption
methods.description: Draws a caption text above a specified box in an image.

methods.name: draw_boxes
methods.description: Draws multiple boxes on an image.

methods.name: draw_detections
methods.description: Draws detection results, including bounding boxes and labels, on an image.

methods.name: draw_annotations
methods.description: Draws annotation boxes and labels on an image.
